lrw.text: Kinsbaile is a kithkin village where Colfenor hosts the Festival of Tales, and where he hires Ashling through Gaddock Teeg to reunite him with the Gilt-Leaf elf Rhys.
Nath arrives and lays siege to Kinsbaile, and Teeg welcomes him openly, so the village falls immediately as Nath and Gryffid wait for Rhys to return.
Rhys returns, fights his former tribesmen, kills Nath and drives the elves out of the village, sparing Kinsbaile.
Then Ashling's rekindling by a greater elemental sets Colfenor burning, damaging buildings and costing Teeg his life, and after the Great Aurora Kinsbaile becomes Kinscaer.

mor.text: Kinsbaile is where Colfenor declares Rhys his final pupil and asks him to plant his seed cone in the Murmuring Bosk.
Nath and Gryffid ambush the party there and Nath challenges Rhys to a duel, in which Rhys kills Nath by twisting his head by the horns until his neck snaps, and the elves let him depart.
Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental, and Colfenor burns to death as planned, promising to see Rhys again.

shm.text: Kinsbaile is where Colfenor goes to set his plan in motion after being alerted to a great coming event, meeting Gaddock Teeg and retaining Ashling to reach Rhys.
Colfenor and Rhys reunite there, and Colfenor sends Rhys to plant his seed cone at the Murmuring Bosk, while Nath and Gryffid come to ambush Rhys and annex the village.
Rhys is trapped by his former tribesmen but kills Nath, and the siege of Kinsbaile is broken.
At the Festival of Tales Colfenor shares the stories of his long life, and Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental, whose fire engulfs Colfenor, who dies as the last yew.
